scripts.build: npm run build -w @escuelas/domain && npm run build -w functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @escuelas/domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-escuelas-rules "npm run test:rules -w functions"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-escuelas-integration "npm run test:integration -w functions"
scripts.seed:emulator: npm run build -w @escuelas/domain && tsx scripts/seed.ts --target emulator
scripts.seed:dev: npm run build -w @escuelas/domain && tsx scripts/seed.ts --target dev
scripts.smoke:dev: npm run build -w @escuelas/domain && tsx scripts/smoke-dev.ts --target dev
scripts.smoke:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-escuelas-smoke "npm run seed:emulator && tsx scripts/smoke-dev.ts --target emulator"
